reviews.comment:
Sobre el rio lujan enfrente al ACA. Amplio muelle con varios picos de surtidor para llenar tanques y seguir navegando. Tienen tarjetas de crédito 💳 y de débito.  Lugar imprescindible ya que hay muchos lugares para repostar combustible en el delta. Atienden horario corrido.

(Translated by Google)
On the Luján River, across from the ACA (Automobile Club of Argentina). A large dock with several pumps for filling up tanks and continuing your journey. They accept credit and debit cards. A must-stop, as there are many fuel options in the Delta. Open all day.
